purpose: Lift the residual smooth F_NP amplitude/width degeneracy with one scalar b-moment per x, rather than anchoring the full function.

moment_definition.target: pointwise-in-x median of twelve independent unregularized data-fit basin moments
moment_definition.descriptive_nonuniqueness: The source q16/q84 moment distribution is retained for later propagation and is not collapsed into a Gaussian error.

adaptive_rule: Advance strengths in ascending order. Stop at the weakest strength for which all three endpoints pass the unweighted fit ceiling and the x=0.1,bT<=2 cross-start F_NP full range is at most 5%.
stationarity_rule: A passing initial range must undergo unchanged-objective continuation before extension to the final independent-start ensemble.
